text:
Morgan: starting a short thread to align on a 'staged verification' approach for onboarding. core idea: run breaking runtime/determinism checks early, then progressively more expensive checks only when needed. want to capture triggers, ownership, and console states.
Zoe: can you outline the stages you have in mind?
Morgan: Stage 0: intake fingerprint + quick lint (tokenizer hash, declared max_seq, quant_kind) ~instant. Stage 1: runtime-smoke (container load, KV presence, no segfaults, tokenization roundtrip) ~1-2m. Stage 2: determinism/compat (KV-layout parity, kernel-map, small deterministic replay) ~5-15m. Stage 3: behavioral validation (golden-set evals, distribution checks) hours.
Ravi: how do we avoid running Stage 3 for every tiny patch? cost will explode.
Morgan: plan: Stage 3 is gated. triggers for full behavioral validation: arch change, quant_kind change, tokenizer change, or Stage 2 reporting non-determinism/diff above threshold. Otherwise run a delta-check: small stratified sample vs last-approved model.
Helena: what's in the delta-check?
Morgan: 120 stratified prompts across short/med/long + 30 intent-focused examples. compute embedding cosine + answer-similarity score + a lightweight hallucination heuristic. if delta < X, mark DELTA_PASS. if DELTA_FAIL -> enqueue Stage 3.
Zoe: we need concrete thresholds and owners. also telemetry naming so Console can show it cleanly.
Ravi: propose thresholds: embedding cosine >= 0.9 and answer-similarity >= 0.75 for DELTA_PASS; these are initial and subject to tuning. ownership: eng-ml owns Stage 0-2 infra and telemetry pipeline; product-ops owns golden-set + Stage 3 thresholds and triage.
Helena: console states: INTAKE_DONE, SMOKE_PASS, SMOKE_FAIL, COMPAT_PASS, COMPAT_WARN, COMPAT_FAIL, DELTA_PASS, DELTA_FAIL, VALIDATION_PENDING, VALIDATION_PASS, VALIDATION_FAIL. teams can map those to rollout policies per-tenant.
Morgan: add a compact intake fingerprint so Stage 0 can be very fast. example fields to capture: model_id, arch, tokenizer_hash, quant_kind, kv_layout_signature, export_tool, declared_max_seq. storing kv_layout_signature helps Stage 2 compare shapes quickly.
Zoe: example intake JSON snippet please?
Morgan: small example in practice: intake: {model_id: rdx-neo-4b, arch: neo-4b, tokenizer_hash: sha256:aa22, quant_kind: q4_1, kv_layout_signature: sha256:bb33, export_tool: onnx-export-v2, declared_max_seq: 4096}.
Ravi: how to handle flaky failures in SMOKE/COMPAT due to infra quirks? false negatives will block.
Helena: add retry/backoff policy and run critical checks on a controlled CI pool to reduce variance. SMOKE failures create an intake ticket and run one auto-retry; COMPAT failures trigger 2 retries across fresh hosts before failing.
Zoe: rollout integration: how do the signals map to automatic gating?
Morgan: default mapping: block global rollout on VALIDATION_FAIL and COMPAT_FAIL for prod-tenants; DELTA_FAIL triggers automatic staging to shadow/limited canary and schedules Stage 3. dev-tenants default to ignore DELTA_FAIL. All mappings configurable per-tenant in Console.
Ravi: what about automated rollbacks post-rollout if regression surfaces in SHADOW or metrics?
Helena: tie Shadow monitors to rollout controller with an SLA window. e.g., if top-5 intent quality degrades > Y% for 30 continuous minutes, auto-suspend candidate and shift traffic back to previous model. product-ops defines Y; suggest initial Y=4%.
Zoe: ownership of alerts? who gets paged?
Morgan: summary: eng-ml paged for COMPAT_FAILs that look like infra/determinism problems; product-ops paged for VALIDATION_FAIL or post-rollout quality alarms for prod tenants. early stages ticketed to ENG-ML but not paged immediate.
Ravi: telemetry retention and UX: we need short summary cards in Console and links to full reports. small report for each stage: key metrics + min example failures.
Helena: agree. also we should store fingerprint diffs and kernel-map diffs in the report. useful for root-cause.
Zoe: action items?
Morgan: 1) Morgan+Ravi: draft numeric thresholds for DELTA and COMPAT and retry policy. 2) Helena: prototype Console state mapping and a short UI mock. 3) Zoe: own PRD for intake fingerprint fields and example schema. 4) Create intake ticket for tuning run against last 50 model admissions to estimate false-negative rate.
onboard-bot: created ticket ONB-12458 "staged-verification: thresholds + intake schema" (assignee: Zoe).
Ravi: I'll run a sim on the last 60 models and report expected cost savings vs running full validation always.
Helena: I'll mock the Console cards and include a compact CSV export for auditing.
Zoe: i'll collect owners and finalize PRD. thumbs if you agree with staged approach and action items. :thumbsup:
Morgan: thanks, closing thread for now.
